sessions.session_title: Check-in conversation – brief status update|Barrier removal – problem-solving or coordination support (Daisy Boynton)
sessions.notes_text:
CONTACT SUMMARY:
Reentry Navigator Daisy Boynton completed a check-in phone call with Charlton Bryant. Charlton reported that his current temporary agency work has slowed down significantly due to the holiday season. He is actively seeking stable housing, as Star Gospel and One80 Place are currently at full capacity. Daisy discussed transitional housing options near the Turn90 center that are on the bus route. 

CASE PLAN GOAL PROGRESS:
- Find stable housing (IN PROGRESS): Discussed transitional housing options (Shield Ministries and Bounce Back). Charlton stated he can try to save up money next week to cover the weekly fees ($175/week) to secure a bed.
- Find employment (IN PROGRESS): Charlton is utilizing temp agencies but needs consistent work to afford rent.

BRIEFCASE & GATE 1-4 UPDATES:
- Housing Plan [Gate 2]: Identified active barrier. Navigator provided referrals to two housing programs near the center.
- Transportation Plan [Gate 2]: Client currently has a 1-day bus pass and requested additional passes to maintain his ability to travel to temp jobs. 
- Reliable Phone [Gate 1]: Flagged as at-risk due to a severely cracked screen.

REFERRALS & RESOURCES PROVIDED:
- Housing: Shield Ministries ($175/wk)
- Housing: Craig Road affordable housing option
- Turn90 Core Program details (Waitlist requirements: stable housing and transportation)

NEXT STEPS:
- Navigator: Text the phone numbers for the two housing referrals to Charlton.
- Navigator: Check with Justin regarding the availability of bus passes and inform Charlton.
- Client: Call the housing referrals to determine intake availability and cost requirements.
- Client: Continue saving money from temp work to afford initial housing fees.
